oopShare.limitations: The US figure leaves out health insurance premiums, which most people there pay themselves, so it would make US healthcare look nearly free to use.

eatingOutPriceLevel.basis: Price level of restaurants and hotels relative to Finland, World Bank International Comparison Program 2021.
eatingOutPriceLevel.limitations: The programme prices restaurants and hotels together, so hotel prices are part of this figure.

coldestMonthMean.basis: Average temperature of the coldest month, Sacramento Executive Airport, climate normals 1991-2020.

warmestMonthMeanMax.basis: Average daily high of the warmest month, Sacramento Executive Airport, climate normals 1991-2020.

decemberDaylight.basis: Sunrise to sunset on 21 December at latitude 38.58°, calculated.

foreignBornShare.basis: Foreign-born residents as a share of the population of the city of Sacramento (American Community Survey 2020–2024, 5-year, Census QuickFacts).

cityWide.basis: HUD Fair Market Rents for FY2027 (from 1 October 2026), Sacramento--Roseville--Arden-Arcade metro area, as republished by VoucherMatch and agreed by Fair Market Rent Map: the 40th percentile of gross rents paid by recent movers, including utilities except phone and internet.
cityWide.limitations: Read from republications of HUD's table, not HUD's own site; a metro-wide figure. FY2026 was $2,255 for two bedrooms. To be checked against HUD before 1.0.

healthcarePerPerson.basis: Employer health plan: the average worker share of a single-coverage premium ($1,440 a year, KFF 2025) plus out-of-pocket spending per person ($556.6 billion in 2024, CMS, over 340.0 million people).
healthcarePerPerson.limitations: Assumes an employer plan. Without one, marketplace premiums are much higher; family coverage costs the worker about $6,850 a year.

carMonthly.basis: AAA Your Driving Costs 2025: a new small sedan costs 55.87 cents a mile to own and run, $8,381 a year at 15,000 miles, including depreciation, finance charges, fuel, insurance, maintenance and fees.
carMonthly.limitations: A national average; insurance and fuel cost more in some states, including California. The running share is AAA's all-vehicle split applied to a small sedan.

carRunningMonthly.basis: What remains once the car is paid for: fuel, maintenance, insurance and fees make up 52.8% of AAA's average new-vehicle cost ($6,113 of $11,577), applied to the small sedan: about $369 a month.
carRunningMonthly.limitations: A national average; insurance and fuel cost more in some states, including California. The running share is AAA's all-vehicle split applied to a small sedan.

groceriesPerAdultEquivalent.basis: Average spending in Finland on food and drink at home, €362 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: 1.06 USD for each euro spent in Finland.
groceriesPerAdultEquivalent.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

communicationsPerAdultEquivalent.basis: Average spending in Finland on phone and internet (services and devices), €70 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: 2.20 USD for each euro spent in Finland.
